About Burlington Berries
Burlington Berries is a leading berry production company located in the fertile Northern Midlands of Tasmania. Known for delivering high-quality strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries to major national retailers, Burlington Berries combines innovative growing techniques with sustainable farming practices. Our operations combine leading horticultural practices with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation, and excellence in every stage of berry production. Our team is passionate about excellence in horticulture and dedicated to producing premium fresh produce for Australian consumers.

Position Overview
The full-time Irrigationist Assitant supports the planning, maintenance, and execution of irrigation systems across Burlington Berries’ production areas. Working under the direction of the Irrigationist, this role is hands-on and operationally focused, ensuring that all irrigation tasks are carried out accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner. The role is ideal for someone looking to grow their technical skills in a fast-paced, high-yield berry farming environment.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks
Irrigation Support and Execution
•	Assist in daily irrigation operations including the setup, adjustment, and monitoring of drip lines, valves, and other water delivery infrastructure.
•	Execute irrigation schedules as directed, ensuring water application matches crop requirements across different berry varieties and stages of growth.
•	Observing the crop daily to ensure optimal fertigation programs

System Checks and Maintenance
•	Conduct routine inspections of irrigation systems to identify leaks, clogs, or wear-and-tear on components.
•	Support filter cleaning, emitter flushing, pressure checks, and other maintenance activities to ensure optimal system performance.

Data Logging and Communication
•	Record irrigation and fertigation activities as required, including volumes applied, timing, and any system faults.
•	Recording  water and fertiliser use and report on for each crop type
•	Communicate effectively with supervisors, agronomists, and other team members regarding field conditions, task completion, and issues requiring escalation.
•	Attending daily meetings to help align the irrigation/fertigation plans with the daily climatic changes and crop requirements

Infrastructure Installation and Upgrades
•	Assist with installation and modification of irrigation lines, control valves, filters, and pumps for new planting blocks or seasonal adjustments.
•	Work alongside contractors or in-house teams during major system upgrades or expansions.

Fertigation and Nutrient Delivery
•	Prepare and apply fertigation mixes under guidance, ensuring accurate dosing through injection systems.
•	Monitor fertigation equipment during runs and report any issues or anomalies promptly.

Key Skills and Attributes
•	Willingness to learn and apply technical irrigation and fertigation skills in a commercial horticulture setting.
•	Good attention to detail, especially when working with measurement, timing, and calibration tasks.

At City Beach, our people are at the core of what we do, both our customers and our team. All are welcome under the City Beach roof, where value is placed on individual style, teamwork, authenticity, adaptability, and a desire to exceed expectations. 

We stock some of the world's biggest brands across surf, skate, streetwear, and fashion. Our stores are a hub that connect our customers to events, influencers, and trends, allowing them to live life on their terms. 

The role:
As a Software Developer and Database Administrator for City Beach, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, maintaining and supporting applications and database platforms and related data services to ensure data integrity, security, backup, reliability and performance. The role also supports internal reporting and analytics solutions by ensuring data structures, SQL queries, integrations and documentation are accurate, secure and maintainable. This is a full-time position working an average of 38 hours per week based in Brisbane, Queensland.  

Key Responsibilities:
Design, configure, maintain and support database management systems, database architecture, schemas, tables, data structures, data dictionaries and naming conventions to ensure data accuracy and completeness. 
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain internal software applications and tools. 
Implement, administer and monitor database security, access controls, data integrity controls, backup processes, recovery procedures and disaster recovery planning. 
Perform operational and preventative maintenance for database environments, including scheduled backups, recovery testing, patching, capacity checks and routine health monitoring. 
Write, maintain and optimise SQL queries, stored procedures, views, data extracts, transformations and data models to support reporting, analytics, integrations and operational decision-making. 
Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve database issues, application data issues, performance concerns, failed jobs, data quality exceptions and other incidents affecting business systems whilst encompassing workstations and communication infrastructure.   
Test database systems and upgrades by debugging, tracking, reproducing, logging and resolving issues in accordance with approved testing scripts, procedures and quality processes. 
Prepare and maintain database documentation, including data models, data dictionaries, standards, operational procedures, security guidelines, recovery instructions and system logs. 
Monitor database, application and infrastructure performance to ensure system components operate reliably together, and recommend enhancements to improve availability, scalability, security and performance. 
Develop, maintain and enhance internal reporting solutions and dashboards, including Power BI reports and business performance dashboards, using accurate and governed data sources. 
Collaborate with stakeholders, security vendors, software suppliers and service providers to analyse user, system, database and reporting requirements and deliver practical, secure and maintainable technical solutions. 

About You:
Bachelor’s degree in relevant field or minimum 5 years experience in a similar role
Strong technical knowledge of database administration, database design, data modelling, relational database concepts and data analysis techniques. 
Sound understanding of programming languages such as C#, C++, Python. 
Strong technical knowledge of data models, database design, development, and data analysis techniques 
Proven experience maintaining database environments, including backup and recovery, data integrity controls, performance monitoring, troubleshooting and disaster recovery practices. 
Proficient in writing, maintaining and optimising SQL queries, stored procedures, views, extracts and data transformations. 
Sound understanding of database security principles, access controls, auditability, operational risk and change control processes. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards and data visualisations, including Power BI or similar tools, using accurate and governed data sources. 
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to collect, interpret, and present complex data with accuracy and attention to detail. 

Why Join Us: 
40% team member discount for you, your friends and family to access. 
Access to our Beach Benefits Program where we have partnered with industry leaders to bring our team members discounts on products and memberships to keep you healthy on all fronts. 
Access to Psych Health our Employee Assistance Program. 
Prezzee Gift Cards for major milestones and yearly anniversary celebrations. 
Weekly shared morning tea to celebrate team member milestones. 
Friday 4pm finishes and social drinks every week.? 

Annual income for standard 38 hour week is $85,000 to $95,000 plus superannuation commensurate with industry rate, skills and experience.  

City Beach appreciates the value of a diverse workforce, and we are passionate about actively seeking to accommodate the unique needs of all people. We are committed to building an environment that respects, celebrates, and empowers individual differences. Above all, City Beach aims to ensure everyone is treated with dignity and respect.

We have a vast range of experience in all aspects of heavy engineering meaning that we can manage, monitor, repair, revive and restore heavy machinery across many industries.

ABC Heavy Engineering are seeking to employ suitably qualified PAINTERS to join our busy team of professionals working out of our Paget depot and various field sites in Queensland.
We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read blueprints/instructions, examine, and understand surfaces to determine the kind and amount of work necessary
Make work preparation such as scaffolding, covering fixtures
Responsible for mixing, matching, applying paint to various surfaces, and completing touch-ups
Be able to understand and complete works to specifications
Be able to mix correct ratio two-part paint coatings etc
Proper appropriation of consumables and materials to avoid wastage
Select paints, varnishes and stains to various surfaces using brushes, sprays, and rollers
Understand the use of Wet Film Thickness Gauges and be able to achieve specified dry film thickness
Able to carry out minor repairs as and when deemed necessary
Use different tools and brushes to apply paints with attention to details
Be able to work at heights and in confined spaces
Erecting scaffolding and ladders
Cleaning equipment and work areas
Support other team members to ensure completion of projects are on-time and in accordance to specification

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade Certificate –Certificate III in Surface Preparation or equivalent (for Blaster/Painters)
High Risk Licence for EWP and/or Forklift
Trade Qualifications in Protective Coatings (ACA, NACE, ICorr, or other trade certs)
HR licence, high risk licence with EWP and Forklift
Drivers Licence (MR or HR class)
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Ability to meet strict deadlines
Strong communication skills
Keen attention to detail
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
